desc:
"what are you doing"
"im doing some jujutsu shenanigans" (tell that to your friends)

1,2,3,4 - skills
Q - dash (use in stun to escape)
F - block
R - special
W+W - sprint (automatically avoids obstacles)
G - awaken

combat based off many battleground games
destruction inspired by combat mayhem
